title: feat(cli): POLLINATIONS_ENV=staging
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `POLLINATIONS_ENV=staging`: polli talks to `staging.gen` / `staging.enter` and keeps its login in a separate `~/.pollinations/credentials.staging.json`
- Staging logins omit polli's `client_id`, because that prod app key doesn't exist on staging and the consent page would reject it
- `models --stats` uses `BASE_URL` instead of a hardcoded prod URL
- Bumps `@pollinations/cli` to 0.1.20; merging publishes it to npm

```bash
POLLINATIONS_ENV=staging polli auth login
POLLINATIONS_ENV=staging polli gen text "hi"
```

Tested: staging whoami/models/login hit staging hosts; prod requests and login body unchanged; 263 tests pass. Scope is core commands; harness installs and `polli upload` (no staging media host) not tested on staging.

gist.headline: Polli visits the staging garden
gist.blurb: Polli can now take the staging path without bringing a production login along. Even `models --stats` knows which garden it’s in.
gist.summary: @pollinations/cli 0.1.20 adds `POLLINATIONS_ENV=staging` for core commands, routing them to staging.gen and staging.enter with separate credentials, staging-compatible login, and environment-aware model stats.
gist.impact: CLI users can log in and test core commands against staging without changing their production login; staging upload and harness installs have not been tested.
